parameters.query:
SELECT
  mc.name AS category_name,
  mi.name AS item_name,
  mi.description,
  mi.is_active,
  mv.variant_name,
  mv.price
FROM menu_item mi
JOIN menu_category mc ON mi.menu_category_id = mc.menu_category_id
LEFT JOIN menu_variant mv ON mi.menu_item_id = mv.menu_item_id AND mv.is_active = true
WHERE mi.restaurante_id = {{ $json.restaurante_id }}
  AND mi.is_active = true
  AND mc.is_active = true
  AND (
    '{{ $json.categoria }}' = ''
    OR lower(mc.name) ILIKE '%' || lower('{{ $json.categoria }}') || '%'
  )
ORDER BY mc.sort_order NULLS LAST, mc.name, mi.name, mv.price NULLS LAST
